Question 4
?

Given that g(x,y,z)=x3z4+y3z2, find ∂g∂r, where (x,y,z) are Cartesian coordinates and (r,θ,z) are the corresponding cylindrical polar coordinates.

a
3r2z2(z2cos3⁡θ+sin3⁡θ)
b
z2cos3⁡θ+sin3⁡θ
c
r2z(z3cos3⁡θ+zsin3⁡θ)
d
3r2z2(cos⁡3θ+sin⁡3θ)
e
3r2(z2cos2⁡θ+sin2⁡θ)
